propositions: Rename three CLI verbs from legacy top-level forms (bridge-fsck, bridge-probe, jira-onboard) to canonical nested bridge subcommands (bridge fsck, bridge check-access, bridge setup) while preserving old spellings as compatibility entrypoints
Every enumerated in-tree consumer—including CLI dispatch, help text, schema definitions, scripts, workflows, tests, and documentation—must migrate to new verb names in the same atomic change
bridge setup must call bridge check-access as its final validation step with environment overlay and --no-validate escape hatch, preserving existing wizard behavior and persisted configuration

Both old and new verb spellings must route to identical implementations with identical behavior, options, exit codes, and output schemas; behavioral parity tests prove equivalence across help, arguments, stdout/stderr, and success/failure modes
Schema $id and description in bridge_fsck.schema.json must update to new verb name; all schema-coverage and MCP-contract tests must pass against the new registration

String-named consumers and monkeypatch targets must be migrated with grep validation; docs, workflows, and canary scripts invoke new verbs while compatibility registrations remain functional for existing environments
